en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view of a riverside town with a large hilltop castle complex, church steeples, dense historic houses, a small weir or dam on the river, and factory chimneys with smoke. The foreground is the river with trees; the title "Gruss aus Colditz." is printed in red script beneath the image, with the publisher credit in small type at the lower left.
